title: Learning to Filter Outlier Edges in Global SfM
one_line: Transformer GNN过滤位姿图异常边，提升全局SfM定位精度
innovations: Line graph transformation for edge filtering
Clustering approach to handle large pose graphs
Integration of image embeddings with GNN for outlier detection
method_framework: Transform pose graph to line graph, apply TransformerConv GNN for binary classification of edges as inliers/outliers, use clustering to handle large graphs
experiment_framework: 1DSfM, PhotoTourism, ScanNet datasets; compare with 1DSfM, Triangle filter, CleanNet; metrics: mean/median position error, position recall
takeaways: Line graph representation effective for edge filtering
weaknesses: Memory complexity still limiting for very large graphs
Single scene training may limit generalization
relevance_reason: SfM异常过滤与可靠性主线无实质交点
